summary.text: Davenport is the Green Party nominee for Michigan's 1st District, advancing from the Green Party convention on July 18, 2026. According to Ballotpedia, she is the founder of a nonprofit organization.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists her as the founder of Levadeh, a nonprofit organization that focuses on health, education, relationship and ownership.

sources.title: United States House of Representatives elections in Michigan, 2026
